raw_segments.text: Posthumous, I embrace these conditions. Let us have articles betwixt us. Only thus far
you shall answer. If you make your voyage upon her and give me directly to understand
you have prevailed, I am no further your enemy. She is not worth our debate. If she remain
unceduct, you're not making it appear otherwise, for your ill opinion and T.H. Assault you
have made to her chastity you shall answer me with your sword."
